title: GrainCallRequest
description: RepairOS -> Grain: POST /call (JSON, <= 80 MB, synchronous today) -- one call for the assistant: scan, readings, photos and loose files in; ordered fixes out. The same parameters GET /call/schema describes. Pinned against the private recorded Grain fixtures (private/grain/observed/, from Sritej; a stored-photo reference is a request Grain rejects), plus target fields marked x-target. Grain requires only `project`. RepairOS rules on top: scan by id (uploaded beforehand), align none and crop false (we pre-align and crop), never photos or rebuild in a synchronous call (slow; G3), send every reading so far. Retry safety (target T10) is an Idempotency-Key header, not a body field. Grain owns the shape: additionalProperties allowed.

project.description: Grain project id of the product model.

scan.description: {id} of an uploaded scan (RepairOS), or {name, units, data_base64}.

name.description: Must end in the format's extension.

photos.description: Now: inline {name, data_base64} only, and slow, so RepairOS never sends photos here (photo upload + /look instead). A stored photo cannot be referenced today (Grain answers 400; G24). Target T5: {record, n} for a stored photo.

tolerance_mm.description: Default 2. Grain may use a larger tolerance than asked; the diagnosis reports the one it used.

rebuild.description: Default false. RepairOS never sends true in a synchronous call (slow).

question.description: What the person asked; passed back unchanged. Until T4, it also carries a compact text copy of our findings.

findings.description: Target T4: RepairOS findings for Grain to cross-check, not re-judge. A vision finding with confidence >= 0.8 counts like a photo flag.

not_inspected.description: Target T4: subject ids no still covered or the user skipped; Grain never returns them ok.

design_trust.description: Target T4: low = the reference is a reconstruction; fixes are advisory.

detach.description: Target T6: return 202 {call_id} at once; poll GET /call/{call_id}.

subject.description: Target T3/T4: what a fix or finding is about. id is a Grain part name (diagnose parts[].name), a harness wire name, a net name, or a file path. RepairOS Finding.subject.ref maps onto id.

photo.description: A photo already on the record, by name or record:n (T5).
